name: spatial_dense_reach_level2_wrist_25d
description: A robotic reaching benchmark that measures dense spatial reachability and wrist pose control in simulated/contact-aware environments. It evaluates a system's ability to produce accurate wrist trajectories and reach targets under contact-rich scenarios. Useful for learning-based control, motion prediction, and imitation learning research.
reputation: Niche benchmark used in contact-aware robotics research and simulation-based control communities.
